recommendedExecutionPlan: Use only root-controlled emulator; create synthetic profiles/pages, record original settings and restore them after testing.

For each shared field: Mac control changes to value A while matching Android panel is open; verify displayed value and server state. Android changes to value B while Mac panel is open; verify displayed value and server state.
Use fixture profiles first; verify coupled profile/startPage changes. Use harmless display/input fields next. Run hidden controls, orientation, idle timers and transport-sensitive fields last.

After the per-field roundtrip, record complete settings maps; run A: both-app restart and B: offline Android restart followed by Mac return. Read all 30 fields plus name after each scenario and compare; field control visibility alone does not prove persistence.
While Mac is stopped, edit multiple Android fields and restart Android before Mac returns. Verify pending edits persist, merge with unrelated Mac fields, then clear after acknowledgement.
Test same-field delayed responses and A-to-B-to-A intent using deterministic fixtures. Server apply order is authoritative; do not infer cross-device wall-clock conflict resolution.
Do not classify Mac-only settings as a failed tablet sync case. Do not count operating a one-shot action as persistence of a scalar setting.

Emulator evidence can establish state/controls/rendering; distinguish vibration, physical brightness, Mac login events, external notification delivery and Wi-Fi hardware effects that require a separate check.

scopeNotes.shared: 30 device settings plus the independently stored device name. These have Mac and Android controls and belong in the bidirectional/restart matrix.
scopeNotes.macOnly: 34 preferences.json settings and 3 auxiliary account/vault policies are host/editor-local. They must not be counted as missing Android controls or falsely marked as tablet synchronization successes.
scopeNotes.androidOnly: Transport preference and endpoint list are Android-local connection settings. Remembered page and selected Grafana project are remembered view state, not shared settings.
scopeNotes.operations: Pairing, permission dialogs, backup/migration, certificate and ADB operations are actions; a button click is not proof that a scalar setting survived restart.
scopeNotes.evidence: Automated API/SSE, synthetic Mac browser UI, native Mac plus emulator, and physical hardware effects are separate evidence categories.
